title: 申万宏源Edong：南向资金占比走低，香港市场风格切换
speaker: Edong (guest)

segments.en: The turn, southbound flows have been on the lower side of things. We, Hangsing Index, 25,500.
segments.zh: 南向资金规模处于偏低水平，恒生指数在25500点附近。

segments.en: We arguably have been stuck at this level for months now. We've touched this level multiple times over the last 12 months. How would you describe sentiment right now? What's the advice for Hong Kong market? What's happened?
segments.zh: 这个点位已经徘徊数月，过去12个月多次触及。当前市场情绪如何？香港市场发生了什么？

segments.en: Well, I think that if you see the southbound trading in this year, so we can see that the southbound trading only accounts for around 20%, which is slightly lower than the average level, 25% in last year.
segments.zh: 今年南向交易占比约20%，略低于去年的平均水平25%。

segments.en: So, we think that if you see the market sentiment in this year, if you see the investor structure, the mainland investors, there's even escape from the Hong Kong market, especially for those leading technology names in the first half of this year, especially from the second quarter of this year.
segments.zh: 今年市场情绪和投资者结构显示，内地资金对香港市场有所回避，尤其是上半年对科技龙头，二季度以来更为明显。

segments.en: So, if you see not only the mutual fund, but also for those ancient companies, they just cut their allocation in the growth sector in Hong Kong market in the first half of this year, but apart from the growth sector for those defensive sector, especially those high dividend yield names like banking, utility, or even some material names in Hong Kong market, these kind of stocks, they are favored by those long-term investors in mainland China, especially for those ancient companies.
segments.zh: 不仅是公募，保险等长期资金也在上半年降低了香港成长板块的配置，但防御性板块，如高股息银行、公用事业和材料股，受到内地长期资金青睐。

segments.en: So, we can see that for these kind of stocks, they outperform their growth sector peers since year to date.
segments.zh: 这些股票年初至今跑赢成长板块。
